subject: Request: Post-report assurance addendum for SOC 2 coverage (SpectraHealth)
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@spectrahealth.com>
To: lukas_meyer@redwood.com
Cc: Security Ops <security@spectrahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SpectraHealth - post-report coverage addendum request

Hi Lukas,

Thanks for the SOC 2 Type II report you previously shared. Our internal security review flagged the audit report end date (2023-05-31) and asked for an attestation to cover the period between that report end and today. Specifically they asked for a short bridge/addendum letter that: (1) confirms there were no control exceptions affecting the SOC 2 scope since the report end date, or (2) describes compensating controls and mitigations if any exceptions occurred.

Can Redwood provide a concise bridge letter (PDF) that we can attach to our audit package? Our auditor has also asked for the following evidence artifacts to substantiate the addendum:
- network diagram showing production boundaries and firewall zones
- KMS key rotation log for any customer data keys since 2023-06-01
- snapshot of firewall rules as of last week
- confirmation of change-control reviews for services updated in the window

We'd like to get this to our auditor by next Friday (2028-05-27). Please let me know timeline and whether you need additional scope clarification.

Thanks,
Elena
Security Engineering
SpectraHealth

--
Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_Report_20230531.pdf (reported previously)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@spectrahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SpectraHealth - post-report coverage addendum request

Hi Elena,

Appreciate the clear ask — we can support this. Looping in Marissa from Compliance and Kim from Security to draft the bridge letter and pull the requested artifacts.

High-level plan:
- Marissa will draft an attestation template and confirm the scope (full SOC 2 scope vs limited modules).
- Kim will coordinate the network diagram and firewall snapshot with InfraOps.
- I will owner-review the final PDF and DocuSign routing for signature.

Marissa/Kim — can you confirm an ETA? Elena asked for delivery by EoD 2028-05-27 to meet their audit deadline. If we need to push, we'll propose an interim attestation.

Thanks,
Lukas
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@spectrahealth.com>, lukas_meyer@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Bridge letter + evidence plan (SpectraHealth)

Hi Elena — thanks, Lukas.

Attached is a draft bridge letter (bridge_letter_draft_20280521.docx) that covers the full SOC 2 scope included in the 2023 Type II report. The draft follows common auditor expectations: it confirms the report scope and states that Redwood is not aware of unremediated control exceptions affecting the in-scope control objectives for the period from 2023-06-01 to 2028-05-24. If any exceptions are necessary to disclose we will call them out with compensating controls and remediation timelines.

Planned evidence package we can provide alongside the signed bridge letter:
1) Network diagram (production boundaries) — network_diagram_202805.pdf
2) Firewall rules snapshot (current) — firewall_rules_snapshot_20280524.txt
3) KMS key rotation log (customer-data keys) — kms_rotation_log_2028_Q1.csv
4) Change-control register export (last 24 months) — will provide as CSV once redacted for internal-only items
5) Signed cover letter (PDF) — we will provide the signed PDF via DocuSign link

Questions for you:
- Do your auditors require the bridge to be on company letterhead and signed by an exec (CISO or Head of Security) or is a compliance manager signature acceptable?
- Are there any particular control areas (encryption, backup, incident response) you want called out in the attestation language?

ETA: We can provide a signed letter + the first three artifacts by 2028-05-24 EOD. Change-control register we can produce by 2028-05-26 pending redaction.

DocuSign routing plan: draft -> Lukas (final review) -> Marissa (sign) -> Elena (recipient). Link: https://app.docusign.com/AAABBBCC12345

If acceptable, we'll finalize and route today.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance & Controls
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: bridge_letter_draft_20280521.docx

From: Elena Park <elena.park@spectrahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, lukas_meyer@redwood.com
Cc: Security Ops <security@spectrahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Bridge letter + evidence plan (SpectraHealth)

Marissa — thank you, the plan sounds good and the ETA fits our window. A couple quick clarifying questions from our auditor before we proceed:

1) Scope: they asked whether the bridge covers managed services split (we only care about the "Production Serving" and "Customer Data Storage" systems). Can you confirm the draft's wording will explicitly reference the production-serving and customer-data subsystems from the SOC 2 scope?

2) Exceptions: if there were any low-severity config changes or one-off maintenance items after 2023-05-31 that required rollback and were remediated, would those be considered exceptions to disclose? If so, can you indicate how you'd present those (redacted, summarized)?

3) Evidence format: our auditor prefers single PDFs where possible. Would you be able to bundle network diagram + firewall snapshot + short evidence index into one PDF for submission?

Also — can you re-send the original SOC 2 report PDF (we had a truncated copy on our side).

Thanks,
Elena
